query_normalized: predicting crystal structures from molecular fingerprints chemistry
rationale: The paper addresses the general problem of crystal structure prediction but uses a physics-based global optimization method (Minima Hopping) rather than the specific mechanism of "molecular fingerprints" (chemical descriptors) requested by the user. It fails to measure the same biological/physical pathway or variable (fingerprint-based prediction) and does not belong to the alternative-vocabulary cluster for fingerprint-based methods, thus satisfying the rejection criteria for distinct construct
